rule: Recognize architectural components before furniture. This inventory records source evidence and references to existing draft geometry, not a second mesh/scene format. Never turn a component into an unknown furniture block.

types.label: 凸窗
types.handling: Reference the enclosing wall paths and hosted glazing once. The projection is not a cabinet or automatically walkable floor.

types.label: 窗台
types.handling: Record source evidence; do not create furniture or floor from a ledge.

types.label: 墙垛
types.handling: Reference its real wall runs once; do not add a second column/solid.

types.label: 独立柱
types.handling: Record a separate structural column. Native Column exists but draft conversion does not yet import it; do not replace it with furniture or hide the gap.

types.label: 管井／竖井
types.handling: Reference source-supported enclosure walls; do not invent access. Walls alone do not preserve a shaft void: current room-floor generation may fill it, so report the missing floor-void support.

types.label: 阳台／露台
types.handling: Reference explicit open floorAreas when the perimeter is supported; a label or bounding rectangle alone is insufficient.

types.label: 设备平台
types.handling: Retain source evidence; do not extend living floor or furniture onto it.

types.label: 固定花池／种植平台
types.handling: Require a drawn built-in planting boundary; loose plant symbols alone do not establish a structural planter.

types.label: 栏杆／护栏
types.handling: Record as a guard boundary; do not promote it to a full-height wall. Physical guard generation is not provided by the inventory.

types.label: 楼梯
types.handling: Record tread/flight evidence and only visible up/down direction. Never infer the destination floor, rise or ceiling hole from a single symbol.

types.label: 挑空／楼板洞口
types.handling: Record an explicit void; never close it with an inferred walkable floor. Current draft-to-3D conversion has no void subtraction contract.
